name: Echoform Tape Mode - Basic Stochastic Jumping
description: Validates tape mode stochastic jumping behavior - random jumps within time window every 2-6 seconds with 0.25s slew

capability_requirements.notes: Tests tape mode stochastic jumping (lines 628-700 in MemoryDelayEngine.h)

full_response.description: Full response - captures multiple jump cycles (2-6s hold intervals)

has_signal.description: Output should have audible energy (tape playback active)

temporal_variance.description: RMS variance should show stochastic jumping behavior (not too stable, not too chaotic)

smooth_transitions.description: Tape jumps should be smooth (0.25s slew) with minimal discontinuities

use_cases: Verify tape mode enables stochastic jumping
Test random jump selection (near vs deep jumps)
Ensure deterministic behavior with fixed seed
pass_criteria: Generates audible output with temporal variance from stochastic jumping, smooth transitions between positions, deterministic with fixed seed
example_failures: No variance → jumping disabled or stuck
Many discontinuities → slew not working (should be 0.25s smooth)
Silent output → tape mode not recording
